text: {"lessons":["A few months of account gains or losses do not show whether my strategy beats the market; I should judge performance over time against a suitable benchmark.","Selling at a loss and later buying back are not automatically mistakes, but each trade should have a clear reason rather than being driven by fear or regret.","Frequent changes can undermine long-run returns, so I should keep positions sized sensibly and trade only when the expected benefit justifies changing course."]}
